questions.text: What is the worst-case time complexity of searching for an element in a balanced Binary Search Tree (AVL tree) with n nodes?
questions.explanation: Because an AVL tree remains strictly balanced with height bounded by 1.44 log n, search takes O(log n) worst case.

questions.text: Which HTTP status code should a server return when a request cannot be processed due to client syntax error?
questions.explanation: HTTP 400 Bad Request indicates that the server cannot process the request due to perceived client error.

questions.text: In relational databases, which normal form eliminates transitive dependencies between non-prime attributes?
questions.explanation: 3NF requires the relation to be in 2NF and have no transitive functional dependencies of non-prime attributes on candidate keys.

questions.text: Which concurrency control anomaly occurs when a transaction reads uncommitted changes made by another transaction?
questions.explanation: A dirty read occurs when transaction A modifies a row without committing, and transaction B reads that uncommitted data.

questions.text: In JavaScript, what is the output of typeof null?
questions.explanation: In JavaScript, typeof null returns 'object' due to a historical design quirk in the first JS engine.

questions.text: What is the primary function of the Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) in computer networks?
options: Resolves domain names to IP addresses
Maps IPv4 addresses to physical MAC addresses
Assigns dynamic IP addresses to network hosts
Translates private IP addresses to public IPs
questions.explanation: ARP operates at the link layer to map known network-layer IPv4 addresses to physical link-layer MAC addresses.

questions.text: Which CPU scheduling algorithm may lead to starvation if a continuous stream of shorter processes arrives?
questions.explanation: Non-preemptive or preemptive Shortest Job First favors shorter jobs, indefinitely delaying longer jobs if short jobs keep arriving.

questions.text: What is the space complexity of Depth First Search (DFS) on a tree of depth d?
questions.explanation: In DFS traversal on a tree of max depth d, the call stack requires memory proportional to the depth of the path, O(d).

questions.text: Which design pattern is best suited for notifying multiple dependent objects whenever the subject's state changes?
questions.explanation: The Observer pattern defines a one-to-many dependency between objects so that when one object changes state, all dependents are notified.

questions.text: A train 180 meters long running at 54 km/hr crosses a stationary platform in 20 seconds. What is the length of the platform?
questions.explanation: Speed = 54 * (5/18) = 15 m/s. Total distance = speed * time = 15 * 20 = 300 m. Platform length = 300 - 180 = 120 m.
